observations: No test was added this round. The comparison round 3 rewrote now decides the drop, the rewrite and the empty-question guard alike (writesNothingButItsText renders the node and the text in it through one renderer), and each of its three answers has a lock: the typed-whitespace rows hold 'text is not markup', the tester's TestAskOptionsEditRefusesDroppingALineHoldingMarkup holds 'markup in a line is not droppable', and TestAskOptionsEditRefusesRewritingALineHoldingMarkup the rewrite arm. The escaping case the tester drove live (a_b*c) cannot break while both sides of that comparison go through the same renderer, so a test of it would pin the design rather than a behaviour.

The CLI cannot make a block holding two bullet lists: an upload whose ask breaks the content rule is refused and a document edit that would leave it so is refused too, measured again this round. Finding 2 therefore rests on the route test alone, and the tester drove the reachable half (a repair carrying options on a one-list block) on the command.
